title: Intergroup Dialogue Facilitator Development & Practicum
description:
Restriction: Students must be given permission to enroll and be admitted to the intergroup dialogue facilitator program.
Cross-listed with: WEID300, CPSP300.
Additional information: Priority is given to students enrolled in a living-learning program. Students interested in serving as a facilitator must first apply online at go.umd.edu/PeerFacilitation2023.
